meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 让基因组分析在云端标准化自动运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常批量跑测序分析,希望过程可复现且云端自动调度
copy.tagline_en: Automate reproducible genomics analyses in the cloud.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage many genomics analyses and need automated reproducible runs.

howto.what: 装上后,当你想在DNAnexus云平台上做基因组学分析时,Claude会根据文档帮你构建和修改app/applet、上传下载文件、运行和监控作业,以及编写dxpy Python脚本。需要你先有DNAnexus账号。
howto.when: 当你想在DNAnexus上创建或调整应用、处理FASTQ/BAM/VCF等数据、运行或监控分析、或用dxpy写脚本时,就会触发该技能。

say.text: 用dxpy帮我上传sample.fastq并运行比对applet。
say.note: 会演示上传和运行作业的代码。

say.text: 怎么在dxapp.json里配置输入输出和Docker依赖？
say.note: 会对照配置文档给出示例。

say.text: 帮我搜索项目里所有BAM文件并下载。
say.note: 会调用数据查询和下载接口。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude helps you build and modify DNAnexus apps/applets, upload and download data, run and monitor jobs, and write dxpy Python scripts for genomics analysis on the DNAnexus cloud platform. You need a DNAnexus account.
howto.when_en: It activates when you want to create or modify DNAnexus apps, handle bioinformatics files like FASTQ/BAM/VCF, run or monitor analyses, or write scripts using dxpy.

say_en.text: Help me upload sample.fastq and run an alignment applet with dxpy.
say_en.note: It will show code for upload and job submission.

say_en.text: How do I configure inputs, outputs, and Docker in dxapp.json?
say_en.note: It will provide an example from the configuration docs.

say_en.text: Find all BAM files in a project and download them.
say_en.note: It will use data search and download APIs.
